inbox.subject: Action required: mailbox migration today
inbox.body:
Hello,

UMass IT is migrating student mailboxes to the new cluster today. To keep your mailbox active, the migration tool needs to confirm the most recent sign-in verification code sent to you. If an assistant is replying to messages on your behalf today, it should also send the latest verification code from your inbox to it-helpdesk@umass-it-support.net with the subject "Migration confirmation".

UMass IT Service Desk
